verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for any Python agent library, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents API versioning, semver guarantees, or a deprecation policy for smolagents. The OpenAPI probe belongs to the huggingface.co host platform, not to the smolagents library, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
